grammar.observed_reference_field: u32 component_count followed by component_count raw32 values followed by separate u32zero terminator. Signed and unsigned component interpretations are both retained, without object-ID assumptions.
grammar.count0: Empty component tuple then zero32. Legacy reader returned stored_reference_tag0/value0.
grammar.count1: One raw32 value then zero32. Legacy reader consumed the pair as one64-bit number; all3494 observed count-one components are positive32 and following32 is zero.
grammar.count2: Two raw32 values then zero32; a separate global separatorzero follows the whole name table. The old8-byte branch would leave an extra zero before the payload-kind length.
grammar.unobserved: Counts3+ and nonzero tuple terminators remain rejected.

audit.procedure: Offline bounded count-array diagnostic over existing saved archives; followup validation below rechecks all11 affected archives without Fusion/API calls.

identity_correction.counterexample: Count2 positive tuple[301,303] appears in six hollow-cylinder face recipes while neither301 nor303 is a primary record in that stream. Positive305 in Emboss tuples coincides with sketch-placement classF47A46FB without a typed recipe reference chain. Negative component magnitudes can coincide with sketch line or parameter record IDs; those numerical matches establish no association.
identity_correction.new_reader: No native-identity lookup or numeric-record collision field is emitted for component tuples, even when a primary record has the same number.
identity_correction.shared_default_repair: Root renamed matching_primary_record to numeric_record_collision with explicit coincidence-only scope; surface constraint field recipe_native_reference_value renamed recipe_stored_numeric_reference_value. Existing historical report snapshots are not identity evidence.
